TeamVoter::supportsAttribute allows only view/edit/delete on a Team, so it abstains on edit_team. findings: GHSA-jv9x-w4gm-hwcm / CVE-2026-41498 is a real missing object-level authorization bug on Team API mutations: subjectless edit_team makes TeamVoter abstain and RolePermissionVoter grant the role permission without isTeamleadOf/admin checks.

The primary correctly identified the landing squash 836a530b8615249ad8854fb5e8a36c08e6cdcd16, parent a31e027c5426ff645d43ef6307b4bc27cfa9937e, later activity extension 0914ebf737dd9f6acc02343cb02d9d8cfe50676e, TeamVoter object check b2d3272151523106027da1d31311bf6fbaf4c7d4, and direct fix cbdf91f316ba9f4ab530127ad19b38fba4df8b0e, and the NOT_AI closed class is right.
Protocol BIC is the reconstructable PR #1384 member 82cd0c5ed2d25631381a603d7b58509dfbccf110, not the squash aggregate. The clone contains those member objects; squash_decomposed must be true.
Human maintainer Kevin Papst authored the atomic BIC and the squash in 2020 with no AI/bot/generator/co-author marker, so the case remains NOT_AI after the BIC correction.
